// Fixture for app_check rule raw-string (not compiled). The test places it at
// lib/features/today/presentation/bad_screen.dart. Every line marked
// `expect: <rule>` must be reported with that rule, and nothing else.
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

class BadScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const BadScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Today')), // expect: raw-string
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Text("Double quotes"), // expect: raw-string
          const Text(
            'On its own line after the widget', // expect: raw-string
          ),
          Text(r'Raw literal'), // expect: raw-string
          Text('''Triple quoted'''), // expect: raw-string
          Text('Hello $name'), // expect: raw-string
          Text(isOn ? 'On' : l10n.off), // expect: raw-string
          Text('Hi ' + name), // expect: raw-string
          Text('مرحبا'), // expect: raw-string
          Text(key: const Key('k'), 'After a named argument'), // expect: raw-string
          SelectableText('Selectable'), // expect: raw-string
          Text(l10n.x, semanticsLabel: 'Spoken'), // expect: raw-string
          Text.rich(TextSpan(text: 'Rich')), // expect: raw-string
          Tooltip(message: 'Tip', child: icon), // expect: raw-string
          IconButton(tooltip: 'Back', onPressed: null, icon: icon), // expect: raw-string
          TextField(
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Name', // expect: raw-string
              hintText: 'e.g. Sam', // expect: raw-string
              helperText: 'Optional', // expect: raw-string
              errorText: 'Required', // expect: raw-string
            ),
          ),
          NavigationDestination(icon: icon, label: 'Today'), // expect: raw-string
          ListTile(title: Text('Row'), subtitle: Text('Detail')), // expect: raw-string
          Icon(Icons.home, semanticLabel: 'Home'), // expect: raw-string
          Semantics(label: 'Weight chart', child: chart), // expect: raw-string
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
